using namespace std;
#include <vector>
#include <iostream>
#include <time.h>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>

// Define macros for readability
#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair
#define X first 
#define Y second

// Define a constant for epsilon value
const double EPS = 1E-15;

// Function to calculate absolute value
double mabs(double a)
{
    if (a  < 0)
        return -a;
    else return a;
}

int main()
{
    // Comment out freopens if not in debug mode
    #ifdef TVISKARON
    freopen("in.txt", "rt", stdin);
    freopen("out.txt", "wt", stdout);
    #else
    //freopen("input.txt", "rt", stdin);
    //freopen("output.txt", "wt", stdout);
    #endif

    // Read input from console
    int x, y, n;
    cin >>  x >> y >> n;

    // Initialize variables
    int a, b;
    double ans = 100000000;
    double d = double((x + .0)) / y;

    // Loop through n iterations
    for(int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
    {
        // Initialize bounds for binary search
        int l = 0, r = 1000 * 1000 * 1000;

        // Perform binary search to find closest fraction
        while(r - l > 10)
        {
            int m1 = l + (r - l) / 3;
            int m2 = r - (r - l) / 3;
            double t1 = mabs(d - (m1 + .0) / j);
            double t2 = mabs(d - (m2 + .0) / j);

            // Update bounds based on closest fraction
            if (t1 > t2)
                l = m1;
            else r = m2;
        }

        // Search for closest fraction in range
        for(int i = l; i <= r + 3; i++)
        {
            double v = mabs(d - (i + .0) / j);

            // Update answer if closer fraction found
            if (ans - EPS > v)
            {
                ans = v;
                a = i;
                b = j;
            }
        }
    }

    // Print result
    std::cout  << a << '/' << b;
}

        {
            int mid1 = lowerBound + (upperBound - lowerBound) / 3;

            // Update bounds based on closest fraction

                lowerBound = mid1;
            else upperBound = mid2;
        }

            {
                closestDifference = difference;
                closestNumerator = i;

            }
